meta.name: seedPrng
meta.notes: s = seed>>>0 || 1; s1 = (s*2654435761)>>>0 computed in JS DOUBLES: when s*2654435761 > 2^53 (productAbove2p53) the product MAY be rounded before >>>0 (e.g. seed -1 gives 1640531968, a uint32 multiply gives 1640531535), so reproduce the double product, not a uint32 multiply; s3 = (s*40503)>>>0 is always exact for uint32 s

meta.name: stepPrng
meta.notes: xorshift128; value = n3 / 4294967295 as an IEEE double (shortest round-trip JSON); value can be exactly 1 when n3 = 2^32-1
